items.title: #Magic forward Tristan da Silva recorded 9 PTS (shot 1 for 6 from 3), 4 REB and 1 AST in 25 mins. to help Germany squeeze past Poland in OT 96-94 Sunday.
items.author: Jason Beede
items.body_excerpt:
#Magic forward Tristan da Silva recorded 9 PTS (shot 1 for 6 from 3), 4 REB and 1 AST in 25 mins. to help Germany squeeze past Poland in OT 96-94 Sunday.

Germany went 2-0 in the fourth FIBA European qualifying window and moved closer to reaching the FIBA World Cup 2027 in Qatar.

items.title: #Magic forward Tristan da Silva recorded 5 points, 6 rebounds and 4 assists with 2 steals during 26 minutes of action Thursday to help Germany cruise past the Netherlands, 99-83, in a FIBA World Cup Qualifier.

items.body_excerpt:

items.title: #Magic forward Tristan da Silva recorded 13 points on 2 for 3 shooting from 3-point range with 4 rebounds and 3 assists during 20 minutes in a 115-82 win vs. Czech Republic in a DBB SuperCup semifinal Friday in Hamburg.
